summary: Iteration 25 testing of Fotuber digital invitation module: print-ready PDF (free), premium PayTR gating (200₺ / 750₺), live photo wall, voice recorder. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests passed (print-pdf across 4 sizes x 6 symbols, pricing/gating for free/premium/photowall, PayTR create for premium/free/other-user, photo wall upload/list/get). Frontend: print page /baskiya-hazir-davetiye works end-to-end (palette Mermer + symbol floral selectable, preview updates, download triggers /api/invitations/print-pdf → 200 PDF, top links present). Wizard has voice-recorder, wizard-print-pdf, toggle-photowall, open-template-gallery→tpl-use-noir, premium-price-note showing 200₺ then 750₺, publish button label 'Yayınla ve Öde · 200₺' / '· 750₺'. Guest page /davetiye/premium-demo-foto shows photowall-card, photowall-name and photowall-upload-label on dark noir theme (gold text readable).

minor.issue: For a free invitation the endpoint returns 400 with message 'Bu davetiye zaten yayında' instead of a more specific 'ücretsiz/ödeme gerekmez' text; still 400 as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: Expected data-testid 'inv-person1' not found on the person1 input. wizard-print-pdf click did not fire a /api/invitations/print-pdf network request (likely because required fields could not be filled via testid — user probably has to fill via placeholder). Consider adding data-testid="inv-person1" and data-testid="inv-event-date" (event-date input also lacks testid, was filled via generic input[type=date]).

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid="inv-person1" and data-testid="inv-event-date" on the wizard's person1/date inputs so automated tests can fill them and trigger the wizard-print-pdf network call.

(Optional) When a free invitation is already auto-published, the PayTR create endpoint could return a clearer message 'Bu davetiye ücretsizdir, ödeme gerekmez.' instead of 'Bu davetiye zaten yayında'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5195 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline and should be split into modules (invitations, payments, admin, media).
_invitation_pricing correctly recomputes price on the server on create/update — client-supplied price is properly ignored (verified by test).
Photo wall upload endpoint enforces 10MB and 1000-photo caps but has no per-uploader rate limiting; consider adding basic IP/uploader throttling to prevent abuse on public endpoints.
Print PDF endpoint has no rate limit either; it can be called anonymously and reportlab rendering is CPU-bound — consider throttling.
test_credentials: Fresh members registered on the fly via /api/member/register. Seed: premium-demo-foto (paid noir photowall), ahmet-yasemin-e9385d (free published).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created several TEST_ member accounts and invitations via public register + POST /api/invitations. Photo wall test uploaded a tiny JPEG to premium-demo-foto (uploader_name=TEST_Guest).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features verified working end-to-end. Only minor gap: wizard person1/event-date inputs lack data-testid attributes; other testids (voice-recorder, voice-record-start, wizard-print-pdf, toggle-photowall, open-template-gallery, tpl-use-<theme>, premium-price-note, print-*) all exist. Container server date is Aug 2026 — use event_date >= 2027 in tests. PayTR link creation returns a real link; do NOT complete payment. Note server.py is 5195 lines — refactor candidate.
